   **Pricing and paywall.**
      1 recent review(s) mention pricing and paywall.
      Review window: Sep 10, 2026 - Sep 10, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention price, subscriptions, or paywalls. This can signal pricing sensitivity in the niche.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _Thursday_, Sep 10, 2026, 1/5: "I've used MFP for over a decade. It used to be the perfect app, but with each update they made it harder to navigate, more and more cumbersome, and they keep taking features we already had and putting them behind a paywall. The app used to be laid out so you could easily see all of your information right up front. Now you have to dig to try to find anything."

## **Bugs and stability** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs and stability.**
      6 recent review(s) mention bugs and stability.
      Review window: May 6, 2026 - Sep 12, 2026
      **Why it matters:** Users mention crashes or instability. Treat as actionable only when volume spikes or follows an update; otherwise it is often baseline noise.

         **Review examples:**
            1. _ben rothan_, Sep 10, 2026, 1/5: "In the past I used this app years ago to track my calories and other metrics so I could lose weight. I lost around 50 lbs at the time, even getting some lingering health issues cleared up. Recently I decided to use this app again. However they have now moved some features that used to be standard into the "premium" subscription, to include the barcode scanner. This "premium" feature now costs $20 a month and is not worth it. If there are better apps, I'd suggest using them instead of this."
            2. _enka cacka_, Aug 21, 2026, 1/5: "broken app, checkout doesnt work, guided onboarding flashing and annoying, cant add a meal adds pop up and screen freeze. what a joke"
            3. _Ein Google-Nutzer_, Aug 16, 2026, 1/5: "Demands an insane amount of access to your personal data. Also, the amount of ads has increased to a level that makes the app unusable."
